corrected_fields.summary: This page documents the Bank of Canada's Staff Economic Projections database, describing its structure, variables tracked (GDP, CPI, unemployment, exchange rates, policy rates), data formats (CSV/JSON/XML via Valet API), and release policies. Data is released with a five-year lag; most recent vintage available is 2019Q4.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This documentation page describes how to access Bank of Canada historical staff forecasts for research purposes. The five-year release lag and 2019Q4 vintage limit relevance to current macro analysis but may be useful for historical research on forecast methodology and monetary policy credibility.
corrected_fields.macro_context: This is database documentation with no current macro relevance. The 2019Q4 vintage predates the COVID-19 pandemic, 2020-2022 inflation surge, and subsequent Bank of Canada rate cycles.
corrected_fields.market_structure_context: The Valet API provides machine-readable access to historical forecast vintages, which could be useful for backtesting or studying central bank forecast accuracy.
